main_text.p: Inde est, Speravit, Fisus, Confisus est, Spem posuit vel collocavit: Construitur cum Præposit. ב, & quandoque תחת. Præterit. ויחסה בו Et sperabit in eo, Recipiet se ad eum, Psal.64.11. Infinit. לחסות תחת כנפיו Ad recipiendum te sub alias ejus, Ruth.2.12.
מחסרת vel מחסה m. Idem: מחסה ומבלי מחסה Et absq; perfu-gio vel obtectione, Job.24.8. Constr. מחסה כזב Receptum fallacia, id est, fallacem, Jesa.28.17. Aff. מחסהו Receptus ejus, Psal.14.6.
חסל Absumpsit, Confumpsit: Futur. כי יחסלנו Quia consumet illud locusta, Deut.28.38.
חסם Obturavit, Capistravit: Part. והחסמת היא Et obturat illa, scil. ora vel nares prætereuntium, Ezech.39.11. Futur. לא תחסום Ne obturato os, ne capistrato, Deuter.25.4.
חסן Chald. Fortis, Robustus fuit: In Aph. אחסן Apprehendit, Possedit. Præterit. החסנו Possederunt, Dan.7.22. Futur. ויחסנון מלכותא Et possidebunt regnum, Dan.7.18.
חסנא Chald. Robur, Potentia, Dan.2.37. Aff. בתקף חסני Robore potentiæ meæ, Dan.4.27.

חסן m. Robur, Jesa.33.6. Item, Thesaurus, Opes, Facultates, quæ Robur & firmamentum hominis sunt, Ezech.22.v.25. Prov.15.6. Hinc Verbum in Niph. unde Futur. לא יאצר ולא יחסן Non reponetur in thesaurum neq; recondetur, Jesa.23.18. synonyma.

page.notes: The Hebrew headwords and examples are copied from the scan; vowel points are not reliably visible, so they are given consonantally. The first headword (הסורת) and the reading of the Hebrew in the line "Et absq;" are doubtful. The catchword (חסף) is bold and uncertain. The reference "1.Reg.8.37" may be "I.Reg." in print. Printed errors are left as they stand.
